Space To Create

To Create

To Create

King O’Holi is a South London–born Performance Director and Choreographer with over a decade of global experience, working with artists such as RAYE, Zara Larsson, Ayra Starr, Sugababes, Little Mix, J Hus and David Guetta. Known for his grounded, culture-led approach to artist development, King creates space for artists to move with intention — building performance, identity and energy from the inside out. As the founder of Space To Create, he leads a new generation of choreographers, performers and creatives, shaping the future of live performance through purpose, collaboration and community.
